profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Friendly and keen on a scent trail, the Small Swiss Hound brings a calm manner to tracking and a determined voice to hunting. It can work independently, searching and driving game with a melodious cry, while keeping a strong attachment to its handler. The breed was developed for Swiss enclosed hunting grounds, where smaller, shorter-legged hounds were preferred to the faster Swiss Hound.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A calm tracker with a melodious hunting cry, the Small Swiss Hound combines independent work with attachment to its handler.
